displayRules: Show relative elevation, metres, with the same horizontal and vertical scales for both sites; label any vertical exaggeration.
Slope is broad-terrain slope; roughness is 500 m detrended topographic RMS, not wheel-scale rock roughness.
Do not convert null conditions into zero, match labels, fit scores or operational clearance.
Earth-only map layers may consume Earth GeoJSON. Lunar coordinates require their explicit lunar CRS.

methods.resampling: Rasterio/GDAL area-weighted average into local projected 100 m pixels; repeat at 200 m as scale sensitivity. No upsampling to fabricate detail.
methods.roughness: RMS residual from least-squares z=a*x+b*y+c fitted to 25 cell-centre elevations in each 5x5 neighbourhood; sqrt(sum(residual^2)/25), no degrees-of-freedom correction.
methods.summary: Equal projected-cell weights, NumPy linear percentiles. 400 overlapping valid cells at 100 m; 100 at 200 m. Elevation relief=max-min of aggregated core.
methods.profile: Two fixed orthogonal grid-axis 2 km transects through each square centre; 21 samples at 100 m; no optimization to resemble either site.
methods.uncertainty: No error propagation; no significance claim for slope/roughness differences. Effective native support is unequal. 200 m is a different support scale, not an error bar.
